rules.scope: provider-level, all 45 RISE series (46 candidate rows)

evidence.says: parameter text: elevation is feet above msl for the location specified datum; no datum is declared for the series
catalog-item verticalDatum null for 45 of 45 bound series
Cheney operates on a project datum coinciding with NGVD29 while the RISE location tags NAVD88: the location tag is not the gage datum
Shasta asset record says NGVD 29 while the location record says NAVD88

rules.caveat: No provider-level rule. Location verticalDatum is unreliable (15 of 45 are EGM96, which is not a reservoir-gage datum; 3 conflict with the asset record). Lake-scoped rules below govern.

rules.scope: lake-scoped, tier A: Reclamation TSC document states the dam gage record AND the pool in one project datum (RPVD / project datum)

evidence.says: Blue Mesa Reservoir: pool top of joint-use pool 7519.4 ft stated in RPVD; gage dam gage records converted to RPVD; datum RPVD is 4.71 ft below NAVD88 (2019 area-capacity tables)

Cheney Reservoir: pool storage allocations including top of active conservation 1,421.6 ft listed in NGVD29 (= Cheney project datum); gage dam gage tied to the Cheney Dam vertical datum coincident with NGVD29; datum project datum coincides with NGVD29; NGVD29 is 0.479 ft below NAVD88 (2015 survey)

Fresno Reservoir: pool surveys use pool 2575 ft on the project datum; gage Reclamation gage record is on the project datum (survey: gage ~4.7 ft above NGVD29 water surface); datum project datum 4.7 ft above NGVD29 and 2.0 ft above NAVD88 (2010 survey; NOT the RISE location NGVD29 tag)

Jamestown Reservoir: pool joint-use storage 1,428.0-1,431.0 ft (top 1431) in the project-datum report; gage water surface recorded by the Reclamation gage at the dam, tied to NGVD29; datum project datum tied to NGVD29; NGVD29 is 1.25 ft below NAVD88 (2009 survey)

Lake Tschida: pool top of conservation pool 2,064.5 ft in the project-datum report; gage gage records tied to the project vertical datum; datum project datum 0.2 ft below NGVD29 and 1.7 ft below NAVD88 (2013 survey; capacity table: gage datum = NAVD88 - 1.7)

Patterson Lake: pool conservation pool 2,420.0 ft in the project-datum report (but the same report digitizes a 2,420 contour as NAVD88: see caveat); gage gage records tied to project vertical elevation; datum project datum 0.1 ft below NGVD29 and 1.9 ft below NAVD88 (2013 survey; capacity table: gage datum = NAVD88 - 1.9)

Box Butte Reservoir: pool pool 4,007.0 ft in the project-datum report; RISE asset record lists 4007 as capacity elevation, vertical datum NGVD 29; gage elevations are based on the project water-surface gage datum; datum project water-surface gage datum tied to NGVD29; 2.0 ft below NAVD88 (2003 survey)

Merritt Reservoir: pool top of active pool 2,946 ft in the project-datum report; gage vertical information referenced to Reclamation gauge measurements tied to NGVD29; datum project datum tied to NGVD29, ~1.0 ft below NAVD88 (2003 survey)

Caballo Lake: pool top of active conservation 4172.44 ft listed with the project-datum allocations; gage survey compares Reclamation gage to RTK; all elevations in project datum; datum project datum 43.3 ft below NGVD29 and 45.5 ft below NAVD88 (2007 survey)

El Vado Lake: pool top of active conservation 6902 ft used as a project-datum elevation (6,902 listed as converted to project vertical elevation); gage gage readings are in the project datum (survey reports the gage-to-NGVD29 shift); datum project datum ~7.8 ft below NGVD29 and 12.0 ft below NAVD88 (2007 survey; add 7.8 ft to reach NGVD29)

Elephant Butte Reservoir: pool top of active storage 4407 ft stated in project vertical datum; gage dam gage records converted to RPVD; datum project datum ~43.3 ft below NGVD29 and 45.5 ft below NAVD88 (2007 survey); 2017/2019 tables: RPVD 45.0 ft below NAVD88, NGVD29 2.1 ft below NAVD88 (the two reports differ by 0.5 ft)

Heron Lake: pool active conservation pool 7186.1 ft in the project-datum report; gage water surface recorded by a Reclamation gage at the dam used for NGVD29 elevations; datum project datum tied to NGVD29; 4.278 ft below NAVD88 (2010 survey)

Navajo Reservoir: pool spillway/top of active 6085 ft stated in project vertical datum; report header lists Vertical Datum RPVD; gage dam gage records converted to RPVD; datum RPVD is 2.97 ft below NAVD88 (2019 area-capacity tables)

Angostura Reservoir: pool conservation elevation 3,187.2 ft in the project-datum report; gage vertical information referenced to Reclamation reservoir water-surface gauge; datum original project datum reported as NGVD29; ~2 ft below NAVD88 (2004 survey)

Flaming Gorge Reservoir: pool top of active conservation 6040.0 ft stated in RPVD; gage RTK checked against dam gage records to establish RPVD vs NAVD88; datum RPVD defined; the 2019 survey states CorpsCon results were inconclusive on whether RPVD equals NGVD29 (absolute datum NOT established)

Bighorn Lake: pool top of joint-use operations pool 3640.00 ft stated in RPVD; gage vertical datum is the Yellowtail Dam water-surface gage, referenced to RPVD; datum RPVD assumed equivalent to NGVD29; NAVD88 minus NGVD29 = 2.63 sft at Yellowtail Dam (2017 tables)
Fontenelle Reservoir: pool top of active conservation 6506 ft stated in RPVD; gage dam gage records converted to RPVD; datum RPVD; offset to NAVD88/NGVD29 not extracted from the 2019 survey

Keyhole Reservoir: pool spillway crest / pool 4,099.3 ft in the project-datum report; gage all vertical information referenced to the Reclamation gauge; datum project datum reported as NGVD29; 2.1 ft below NAVD88 (2003 survey)

rules.caveat: PROPOSED, pending lead acceptance. Residual not documented by RISE: that the RISE daily value is the dam gage record described in the survey. Project datums must never be converted with NCAT/VERTCON; shift only. Absolute datum name is not asserted (Flaming Gorge's own survey could not confirm RPVD = NGVD29). Patterson 2013 labels a 2,420 contour NAVD88: drop to UNKNOWN if Reclamation says the project-datum pool is 2,418.1. Surveys date 1979 to 2019.

rules.scope: lake-scoped, tier B: a datum relation is documented but the gage-to-datum or pool-to-datum link is missing

evidence.says: Havasu: RISE asset record: elevations on USGS 1912/Powerhouse datum (+0.55 ft to NGVD29); location tag agrees; missing: no TSC survey fetched; no gage statement
Shadow Mountain Reservoir: RPVD (offset not extracted); missing: pool 8367 wording not found in the survey
Waconda Lake: project datum ~1.2 ft above NGVD29 (2001 survey; RISE asset: RPVD is 1.2 ft greater than NGVD29); missing: no document found that says the dam gage record is on the project datum
Calamus Reservoir: project datum near NGVD29, 0.84 ft below NAVD88 (2012 report); missing: report pool wording (morning-glory crest 2,244.5) and gage statement not matched to 2,244
Swanson Reservoir: project datum tied to NGVD29, 1.1 ft below NAVD88 (2011 report); missing: gage statement not found

Lake Mead: dam construction (Powerhouse/USGS 1912) datum: add 0.55 ft to reach NGVD29 (2001 survey, 2009 LiDAR report, RISE asset); missing: no document ties the Hoover dam gage/RISE series to the construction datum
Buffalo Bill Reservoir: 1986 survey on 'Shoshone Project Datum'; conversion to USC&GS datum printed but text garbled; missing: gage statement absent; 1986 datum may have been superseded
Glendo Reservoir: project datum ~2.55 ft below NAVD88 (2003 survey); missing: gage-to-datum statement not found; RISE asset says project datum

rules.caveat: Becomes tier A when Reclamation states the gage record is in the project datum, or the survey states the pool in it.

rules.scope: provider-level, all 43 NWPS lakes

evidence.says: the swagger defines no semantics for datums.vertical value; gaugeZeroDatum exists only under inundation
Bartlett table NGVD29=1599.46 matches the USGS gage datum, but NWPS reads 0.54 ft above gage height + that value
Canton lists NAVD88=0.6 while NWPS equals the CWMS NGVD29 series

rules.caveat: HP/HL/HG labels are reliable (stageflow primaryName); datum tables are not. Accept NWPS only through an independent labelled source.

rules.scope: rebind: NWPS Pool is numerically identical to the CWMS Elev series at the project that holds Top of Conservation

evidence.says: CWMS location vertical-datum NGVD29 (also CANT, KAWL, TENK, SKIA; NAO Moomaw)
paired with NWPS JRLK1 hourly, 2026-10-12..14: mean diff 0.000, max 0.00; other lakes mean diff -0.008..+0.001, max abs 0.05 ft
NWPS observed Pool values used in the pairing

rules.caveat: Applies only if the live level is read from the CWMS series (rebind). NWPS-sourced reading alone remains UNKNOWN. NWS datum tables for these gauges are empty or contradictory (Canton NAVD88=0.6, John Redmond NGVD29=995).

rules.scope: rebind: NWPS Pool identical to USGS 62615 (NAVD88) and pool is a CWMS location tagged NAVD88

evidence.says: NWPS YGBP1 minus USGS 62615 over 237 hours: mean 0.0, sd 0.007 ft; 62615 is NAVD88 by USGS parameter definition
CWMS location vertical-datum NAVD88; pool is its Top of Conservation

rules.caveat: Rebind the live source to USGS 62615 or the CWMS series first; the NWPS table is empty.

rules.scope: Duke Energy 'relative' scale: 100.0 ft = full pond, 1 unit per foot (documented definition)

evidence.says: Catawba-Wateree LIP (2006): Licensee refers to Full Pond Elevation for all reservoirs as equal to 100.0 ft relative; full pond (ft above MSL) James 1200.0, Hickory 935.0, Norman 760.0, Wylie 569.4, Wateree 225.5
NWS Norman NGVD29 zero 660 + 100 = 760.0; Hickory 835, James 1100, Wylie 469.4 likewise equal LIP full pond; observed 84 to 100, action stage 100

rules.caveat: shift = scale - 100 (never level - fullPoolFt). PROVISIONAL: that the Duke API/page series is on this scale is not verified (API HTTP 403; page is a JS app). Datum name (NGVD29) rests on NWS metadata only. Needs Duke confirmation.

rules.scope: TVA reading and TVA operating-guide pool are one TVA JSON service (candidates.json status SAME_OPERATOR_SYSTEM); includes Kentucky Lake|TN whose pool equals the guide GuideCurve max 359

evidence.says: guide MidNightElevation 593.70 equals the observed-data-48-hours midnight reading; directory pool 595 equals max TopOpZone; same check passes for all 16 lakes (identical for 7, within 0.05 ft for the rest)
NWS Guntersville tailwater NGVD29 zero 538.2 + stage 17.31 = 555.51 = TVA TailwaterElevation at the same hour
TVA page gives operating range 594-595 ft and winter minimum 593 ft; states no datum

rules.scope: SRP daily report: pool derived as current elevation + 'Remaining Elevation' (feet below maximum conservation storage level)

evidence.says: columns Current Elevation (ft) and Remaining Elevation (ft); glossary: 'Remaining' is how many feet the water is below the maximum conservation storage level; no datum text

rules.caveat: Pool derived by construction, so shift = -Remaining. Roosevelt's pool is a CWMS Top of Conservation (a different provider): derive it from SRP's Remaining column instead to unlock.
